articles.title: Ava Becomes a Certified B Corp, Joining a Global Community Leading Accountability in Healthcare Technology
articles.mainIdea: Ava Becomes a Certified B Corp, Joining a Global Community Leading Accountability in Healthcare Technology
articles.summary: CNW Group: Ava Becomes a Certified B Corp, Joining a Global Community Leading Accountability in Healthcare Technology. Ava Industries (Ava), a Canadian electronic medical record (EMR) provider, has achieved B Corp Certification, placing it among a global community committed to accountability, transparency, and long-term responsibility. Within Canada's EMR landscape, the certification reflects Ava's role in helping lead a shift toward more responsible practices in healthcare technology as the company continues to grow.
